name: Seven-spot Ladybug
note: Seven spots. I counted twice. Bruno counted nine and refuses to discuss it.

name: Honeybee
note: Works harder than anyone in Bramblewick. Present company included. Especially present company.

name: Garden Snail
note: Moves slower than Rufus on a Monday. An admirable commitment to the bit.

name: Leaf Caterpillar
note: Eats its own body weight in lettuce daily. Juniper is taking notes, which worries me.

name: Cabbage White
note: Elegant, plain, and entirely too fond of lettuce. Like Goldie.

name: Bumblebee
note: Aerodynamically impossible. Flies anyway. Pip says this is her whole personality.

name: Shield Beetle
note: Built like a tiny knight. Smells like a tiny knight who has been to war.

name: Blue Dragonfly
note: Hovers like it owns the place. Ziggy has tried to sell me one. Twice.

name: Golden Ladybug
note: Rare. Lucky, according to Goldie. Unremarkable, according to science. I am keeping it anyway.

name: Monarch Butterfly
note: Travels thousands of miles every year. Tobias managed one trip in forty. Just saying.

name: Tiger Caterpillar
note: Striped as a warning. The warning is: I am adorable. It works on Moss every time.

name: Ruby Dragonfly
note: Faster than the eye can follow. I sketched it from memory and a strong suspicion.

name: Stag Beetle
note: Enormous jaws, gentle nature. Bruno says it reminds him of himself. Nobody has argued.

name: Luna Moth
note: Lives one week and never eats. Rufus asked if it was a miller. I laughed. He did not.

name: Purple Emperor
note: Iridescent, imperious, and very hard to impress. We understand each other.

name: Violet Snail
note: Purple shell. No idea why. I have written four papers on it and still have no idea why.

name: Golden Moth
note: Tobias drew this moth in the margin of his almanac in 1979. I told him he'd imagined it. I owe him an apology. And a pie.
